details.title: My details
details.lead: The details of your account. Your INFLUX account manager and our emails use them.

language.label: Language of your emails and your space

messages.unchanged: There is no change to save.
messages.companyRequired: Enter the name of your company.
messages.companyInvalid: The company name can't be longer than 120 characters or contain a tab or a line break.
messages.countryUnavailable: This country can't be chosen at the moment. Your previous country is kept.
messages.unavailable: We can't save your details right now. Your answers are kept: please try again in a few minutes.

email.title: Sign-in email address
email.how: To change your address, we first check that it's really you. Then a code goes to each of the two addresses: your address only changes once both codes are entered, within 24 hours.

pending.stays: Your sign-in address remains {email} until both codes have been entered.
pending.cancelled: Request cancelled. Your sign-in address has not changed.

email.completed: Done: you now sign in with {email}. Your other sessions have been closed.

messages.sameAsCurrent: This is already your sign-in address. Enter another address.
messages.undeliverable: We can't send an email to this new address. Check it, then start again.
messages.unavailable: We can't send the codes right now. Nothing has changed: start again in a few minutes.
messages.freshCodeRequired: The check has expired. Start again: we will send you a new code.
messages.rateLimited: Too many codes have been requested in a short time. Nothing has changed: please try again in a few minutes.
messages.addressUnavailable: This address can't be used for your account. Your sign-in address has not changed.
messages.tooManyAttempts: Too many attempts with this code. The request is closed: your address has not changed. You can start again.
messages.expired: The 24 hours have passed. The request is closed: your address has not changed. You can start again.
messages.gone: This request is no longer open. Your sign-in address has not changed.
messages.invalid: This code is incorrect. You have {remaining, plural, one {# attempt} other {# attempts}} left.
messages.codeUnavailable: We can't check this code right now. Please try again in a moment.

freshCode.title: Let's check it's really you
freshCode.lead: We send a 6-digit code to {email}. It confirms this one action only, for 5 minutes.
freshCode.sent: A 6-digit code has just been sent to {email}. Check your spam folder too.
freshCode.phraseHelp: Check that it is the same in the email you received. If it is different, don't enter the code.
freshCode.stayInTab: Stay in this tab: the code only works here.
freshCode.countdown: You can ask for a new code in {seconds} seconds.

messages.required: Enter the 6-digit code you received by email.
messages.invalid: This code is incorrect. You have {remaining, plural, one {# attempt} other {# attempts}} left.
messages.expired: This code is no longer valid. Ask for a new one.
messages.tooManyAttempts: Too many attempts with this code. Ask for a new code.
messages.sessionLost: This check has expired. Ask for a new code.
messages.tooManyRequests: Too many attempts from this network. Please try again later, within an hour at most.
messages.verifyUnavailable: We can't check your code right now. Please try again in a moment.
messages.undeliverable: We can't send an email to your address. Write to us from the help on the sign-in screen.
messages.rateLimited: Too many codes have been requested in a short time. Please try again in a few minutes.
messages.sendUnavailable: We can't send your code right now. Please try again in a few minutes.

preferences.title: My communication preferences

origin.signupForm: by you, when you signed up
origin.unsubscribeLink: through an unsubscribe link in an email
origin.prospectionOptOut: through an opt-out from our prospecting tool
origin.influx: by the INFLUX team, at your request
origin.dataRequest: following a request about your data

preferences.withdrawHelp: Takes effect immediately. No reason asked.
preferences.grantHelp: You can withdraw this consent at any time, here or from any email.

done.withdrawn: Done: you no longer receive our marketing emails or our prospecting messages.
done.granted: Done: you will receive our marketing emails again.

unchanged.title: What withdrawing does not change
unchanged.introductions: So do the messages about your introductions.
unchanged.account: Your account and your access are unchanged.

preferences.unavailable: We can't save your choice right now. Please try again in a few minutes.

sessions.title: My sessions
sessions.lead: The browsers where your account is open. If one of them doesn't ring a bell, close it.
sessions.help: We recognise a browser by its type and operating system (for example "Firefox on Windows"), never by your location. Two devices of the same type therefore look alike: check the dates as well.
sessions.closeCurrent: Close this session (you will be signed out)
sessions.closeAllWarning: All your sessions will be closed, including the one on this device: you will need to sign in again with a code.
sessions.allClosed: All your sessions are closed, including the one on this device.
sessions.signedOut: This session is closed: you are signed out on this device.
sessions.unavailable: We can't close this session right now. Please try again in a few minutes.

data.title: My data
data.lead: Request a copy of your data, or delete your account.

export.title: Export my data
export.text: You receive a readable file with the data we hold about you.
export.how: A member of the INFLUX team approves your request, then the file appears here: you download it after a code sent to your address. It is never sent to you by email.
export.open: An export request is already in progress: follow it above.

delete.open: A deletion request is already in progress: follow it above.

confirm.title: Delete your INFLUX account

gone.details: Your account details: email address, country, language, status or company name.
gone.crm: Your contact at Brevo and at Apollo.io: the deletion is passed on to them as a priority.
gone.access: Your access: you will no longer be able to sign in.

kept.emails: The emails already sent: they have left our systems and we cannot recall them.
kept.journal: The entries of the activity log, which cannot be changed, in a form that no longer names you.
kept.terms: The record of your acceptance of the terms of use, in a form that no longer names you.

confirm.durations: How long things are kept: see the privacy policy.
confirm.newAccount: Signing up again with the same address will create an entirely new account, unrelated to this one.
confirm.next: You will then be asked for a verification code.

done.access: Export request received. We will reply by {date} at the latest. A confirmation email is on its way to your address.
done.alreadyOpen: A request of this type is already in progress: here it is. No new request was created.

data.unavailable: We can't record your request right now. Please try again in a few minutes.

download.title: Your export is ready
download.text: Available until {date}. You have {count, plural, one {# download} other {# downloads}} left.
download.how: A code is sent to your address before each download. The file is in JSON format, with a notice explaining each category of data.
download.saved: The file {name} is saved on your device.
download.gone: This export is no longer available: it expired or was downloaded three times. You can make a new request.
download.failed: The download did not complete. Try again in a few minutes.

danger.title: Danger zone
danger.warning: Deleting your account is immediate and permanent. It can't be undone. You will be signed out on all your devices.
danger.exportFirst: Download your export first: it will be erased with your account.

deleted.title: Your account has been deleted
deleted.text: A confirmation email is on its way to your address. Signing up again with the same address will create an entirely new account.

terms.title: The terms of use have changed
terms.lead: To keep using INFLUX, read and then accept the new version ({label}), in force since {date}.
terms.fallback: This version doesn't exist in English yet: here is the version in force.
terms.unavailable: The terms of use can't be loaded right now. Please try again in a moment.
terms.accept: I accept the terms of use
terms.refuseHelp: Refusing signs you out. Your account and your data are not deleted: you can accept the next time you sign in.
terms.newerVersion: A newer version has just come into force: here it is.
terms.acceptUnavailable: We can't record your acceptance right now. Please try again in a moment.
terms.rightsText: Even without accepting this version, you can:
terms.rightsData: ask for an export of your data or for the deletion of your account
terms.contact: A question about these terms? The privacy policy tells you how to write to us.
terms.refused: You are signed out. Your account and your data are kept: you can accept the terms the next time you sign in.
terms.pendingNotice: You haven't accepted the new version of the terms of use yet. This page remains available.
